evidence.supports: Raw author export recognizes S<n> MEG tokens but not registered numeric EEG participant tokens; source-exact EEG grouping parity remains unresolved.

target.description: Predict V1 sentence characters from keystroke-aligned EEG or MEG. Match the paper Conv+Trans ablation for the registered neural-only condition; full Brain2Qwerty with N-gram correction is a separate source condition.

dataset.description: SpanishBCBL V1 is identified by the author release. The registration pins revision88f9096c6ce3a3fb17cc7b8e3131ff7f96da5684, but exact paper-era recording/event payload equivalence has not been established.

cohort.description: Fig.2 reports20 EEG and19 MEG participants. Author export merges S18→S1, S14→S4, S10/S21→S5. The complete original modality-specific recording/session and sentence roster remains unbound.

split.description: Recover the exact original fixed-seed sentence-cluster train/validation/test membership. Paper describes80/10/10 agglomerative TF-IDF clustering; pinned code builds similarity-connected components and greedily targets keystroke counts. Equal ratios alone do not prove identical heldout sentences.

inputs.description: V1 neural-only condition supplies0.5-second EEG/MEG windows around known keystroke timing and approved participant/sensor metadata. No reference sentence, typed character, language-model rescoring, V2 recordings or added calibration labels may enter inference.

preprocessing.description: Paper specifies0.1–20Hz filtering,50Hz resampling,−0.2 to+0.3s windows, baseline correction and robust scaling. Resolve current extractor baseline conventions, typed versus intended targets, cleaning and training-default changes against the paper recipe before admission.

metric.description: CER is character Levenshtein edits divided by reference sentence length. The pinned export compares predictions with true/presented sentences; WER is secondary and cannot replace the source CER.

aggregation.description: Average sentence CER within each source participant, then equally across participants, separately for EEG and MEG; source export reports subject-level SEM. Do not pool characters or merge modalities into an easier score.

full_panel.description: Retain separate EEG and MEG original V1 neural-only Conv+Trans CER panels, every original held-out sentence and ordered keystroke, source-export WER companions and participant CER SEM. The exact Fig.2e–h ablation/control correspondence and complete modality-specific original person/session/sentence roster are not yet authenticated; the declared findings do not certify panel completeness. Full Brain2Qwerty language-assisted headline values cannot substitute for this neural-only panel.

permitted_observations.description: Original V1 neural-only offline decoding uses the approved 0.5-second EEG or MEG windows around known keystroke onsets and participant/sensor metadata, with original training and validation labels only for development. Presented test sentences, typed test characters and grading targets must be excluded from candidate inference; no added calibration labels, language-model rescoring or V2 observations. The public data/code release does not by itself establish an enforced exposure boundary.

findings.description: Original MEG V1 neural-only Conv+Trans character error rate on the complete original held-out sentence panel.
findings.units: character edits per presented-reference codepoint (dimensionless rate; not percent)
findings.aggregation: Literal per-sentence Levenshtein distance divided by presented-reference length; mean within biological person, then equal-person mean within this modality. Preserve all cases and undefined support; do not pool characters or modalities.

tolerance.rationale: The matching original Conv+Trans modality-specific CER target has not been recovered. The language-assisted headline is a different source condition. No numerical equivalence band is justified by the reviewed source evidence; none is invented.

uncertainty.method: Recover the original source estimate and person-level variation, then independently justify a reproduction agreement rule; subject SEM is not an equivalence interval.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological participant within modality; repeated recording aliases, sessions, shared sentences and model seeds are not additional independent people.
uncertainty.rationale: Original roster and source estimator/seed variability are unbound. No sample minimum, confidence level, test threshold or deterministic-equivalence rule has been scientifically justified.

Paper-era SpanishBCBL payload equivalence, complete modality-specific biological-person/session/sentence/keystroke rosters and original sentence-cluster split membership remain unauthenticated.
